Name: Magic Rock Candy Making (Cooking or Crafting Recipe)
Author: Cinnamoff
Description:
[b][size=4]Description﻿[/size][/b]
[size=3]Adds a cooking (or crafting) recipe to make Magic Rock Candy using 1 x Prismatic Shard, 1 x Sweet Gem Berry, 1 x Starfruit, and 1 x Mystic Syrup.[/size]

[b][size=4]Configuration[/size][/b][size=3]
Enable/disable each type of recipe (Cooking and Crafting)
[/size][size=3]Toggle easier version (1 x Prismatic Shard and 1 x Mystic Syrup)
[/size]
[b][size=4]Installation[/size][/b]
[size=3]1. [url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
2. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content Patcher[/url].
3. Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
4. Run the game using SMAPI.[/size]

Downloads.Description: Updated Recipe to be more balanced. Added config for easier recipe.
